name: RoboMIND: Multi-embodiment Intelligence Normative Data for Robot Manipulation
description: RoboMIND is a large-scale real-world multi-embodiment robotic manipulation dataset and benchmark comprising 107,000 demonstration trajectories collected across four distinct robotic embodiments: the Franka Emika Panda, Universal Robots UR5e, AgileX dual-arm platform, and a bipedal humanoid robot. Developed by the Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics, RoboMIND spans 479 diverse manipulation tasks and 96 object classes. A defining contribution is the systematic capture of real-world failure demonstrations accompanied by detailed root-cause annotations, enabling research into failure reflection, self-correction, and generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy robustness.
